purpose: Measured MTP cost diagnosis; experimental source and Xbox evidence, not a global performance optimum

mechanism.draft_cpu_pool: existing target pool; unused extra private pool removed in R120

confirmed_causes.cause: Unused catch-up logits forced LM-head work. Suppressing logits exposed rejection of an empty output MUL_MAT, making scheduler copy 521472000 weight bytes to CPU.
confirmed_causes.fix: Accept correctly owned empty output nodes; skip them before GPU dispatch; catch-up requests no logits by default.

confirmed_causes.cause: LM-head matmul previously read/dequantized weights independently for each verification column.
confirmed_causes.fix: Validated two/four-column HLSL tiles within a narrow Qwen shape allowlist.

confirmed_causes.cause: MTP hidden projection Q8_0 and gated delta network used CPU fallback.
confirmed_causes.fix: GPU Q8_0 and GDN shaders, with same-package CPU controls and GPU numerical checks.

confirmed_causes.cause: AUTO attention used the separate CPU graph because D3D12 lacks FLASH_ATTN_EXT.
confirmed_causes.fix: Force existing native fused CPU attention; CPU FA1 is measured faster than CPU AUTO in the pilot, not proof of GPU FA speed.

confirmed_causes.cause: Extra low-confidence draft work raises cost without proportionate acceptance.
confirmed_causes.fix: Tune depth and probability using full-token equality, fresh sequential controls, and repeated confirmation.

required_for_gpu: strict tensor/precision contract and real shape capture
GPU accessible KV placement rather than whole-KV copies
routing offload_kqv while preserving recurrent-state placement
component CPU reference and full MTP-vs-sequential Xbox parity

build_cache.iteration: optimized inference, cached WinRT PCH, no LTCG, persistent objects
build_cache.final: LTCG with separate project prefix ending -final to prevent RelativeDir parent traversal alias

measurement_limits: Compare MTP against a fresh same-package same-config sequential arm.
GPU timestamp is nested inside D3D12 wall, which is nested inside verification wall.
Summed process CPU time across workers is not exclusive wall time.

final_build_repair.cause: SolutionRebuild cleaned the inactive ggml ProjectReference after pre-building its static library, deleting both library and233 GLobjects.
final_build_repair.fix: Clean once before pre-building library; final wrapper uses Build with isolatedGLcache.

long_output_gate_failure.candidate_cause: singlequeryFA split-KV vs multiquery full-KV withF16 partial accumulation

FA2_resolution.scope: original standard-512256 failing case; remaining gates in progress
